question:
**Complete the sentence with an appropriate synonym of the word mentioned in the bracket.**

The party was so amazing that everyone _________ (hated) leaving it.
solution:
The correct answer is** "loathed".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given words.**

 
 
• 
 **loathed**: feel intense dislike or disgust for. (नफरत करना)
 
 
• 
 **enhanced**: intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of. (बढ़ा हुआ, ज़्यादा किया हुआ) 
 
 
• 
 **revered**: 
 feel deep respect or admiration for (something)

 . (परम पूजनीय)
 
 
 
• **embraced**: 
 hold (someone) closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection. (गले से लगाना, संमिलित करना)
 
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**loathed**" is the appropriate synonym for the word mentioned in the bracket.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.**

**The complete sentence is**: *The party was so amazing that everyone **loathed **leaving it.*
